items.title: To clear up some misconceptions, sample size this season is not an issue as this is “EXPECTED” EPM.
items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
To clear up some misconceptions, sample size this season is not an issue as this is “EXPECTED” EPM. 

This uses all previous career data to predict how good a player is if they played today. 

“ACTUAL” EPM is impact metrics for this season only. No player has a big enough sample size yet for that.

images.alt: Screenshot from dunkandthrees.com showing epm where you can toggle from expected vs actual epm.
